description: This file defines API endpoints for managing comments on tasks within projects, using FastAPI. It includes routes for listing, creating, updating, and deleting comments, with dependency injections for database sessions and user authentication.

methods.name: List[CommentOut] list_task_comments( project_id: int, task_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Lists all comments for a specific task within a project.

methods.name: CommentOut create_task_comment( project_id: int, task_id: int, payload: CommentCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new comment on a specified task.

methods.name: CommentOut update_task_comment( project_id: int, task_id: int, comment_id: int, payload: CommentUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates the body of an existing comment, only if the current user is the author.

methods.name: None delete_task_comment( project_id: int, task_id: int, comment_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Deletes a comment from a task, only if the current user is the author.

calls: update_comment(db, project_id, task_id, comment_id, current_user.id, payload.body or "")
